# D04 全概率公式

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D04Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("全概率公式", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D04_1_1", "如果一个结果可以由互不相容的若干原因产生，可以先按原因分类，再计算各分支的贡献。", "", tts_text="如果一个结果可以由互不相容的若干原因产生，可以先按原因分类，再计算各分支的贡献。")
        line_1 = Text("互斥且覆盖全部样本空间", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D04_1_1")
        self.start_cue("D04_1_2", "设事件 B 一到 B n 两两互斥且并集为样本空间，每个概率为正。", "", tts_text="设事件 B 一到 B n 两两互斥且并集为样本空间，每个概率为正。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\bigcup_{i=1}^{n}B_i=\Omega,\quad B_i\cap B_j=\varnothing\ (i\ne j)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D04_1_2")
        self.start_cue("D04_1_3", "全概率公式把 A 的概率拆成条件概率的加权和。", "", tts_text="全概率公式把 A 的概率拆成条件概率的加权和。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"P(A)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}P(B_i)P(A\mid B_i)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_1_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D04_1_3")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D04Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("全概率公式", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D04_2_1", "因为 B 组覆盖样本空间，事件 A 可以分解成 A 与每个 B 的交集。", "", tts_text="因为 B 组覆盖样本空间，事件 A 可以分解成 A 与每个 B 的交集。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"A=\bigcup_{i=1}^{n}(A\cap B_i)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D04_2_1")
        self.start_cue("D04_2_2", "这些交集互斥，因此有限可加性给出概率之和。", "", tts_text="这些交集互斥，因此有限可加性给出概率之和。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"P(A)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}P(A\cap B_i)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D04_2_2")
        self.start_cue("D04_2_3", "再用条件概率乘法公式，即得全概率公式。", "", tts_text="再用条件概率乘法公式，即得全概率公式。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"P(A\cap B_i)=P(B_i)P(A\mid B_i)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D04_2_3")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D04Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("全概率公式", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D04_3_1", "例题：甲乙两台机器分别生产六成和四成产品，次品率为百分之一和百分之三。求随机产品是次品的概率。", "", tts_text="例题：甲乙两台机器分别生产六成和四成产品，次品率为百分之一和百分之三。求随机产品是次品的概率。")
        line_1 = Text("甲 60%，次品率 1%；乙 40%，次品率 3%", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D04_3_1")
        self.start_cue("D04_3_2", "两台机器是互斥且完备的来源，按各自比例加权。", "", tts_text="两台机器是互斥且完备的来源，按各自比例加权。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"0.6\times0.01+0.4\times0.03", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D04_3_2")
        self.start_cue("D04_3_3", "相加得到零点零一八，也就是百分之一点八。", "", tts_text="相加得到零点零一八，也就是百分之一点八。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"P(A)=0.018=1.8\%", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D04_3_3")
```

```python title=scene_04
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D04Part4(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("全概率公式", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D04_4_1", "关键是找到完备事件组，先检查互斥与覆盖，再作加权求和。不能直接把两个次品率相加。", "", tts_text="关键是找到完备事件组，先检查互斥与覆盖，再作加权求和。不能直接把两个次品率相加。")
        line_1 = Text("分类 → 条件概率 → 加权求和", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        line_1.set_color("#1D4ED8")
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D04_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D04_4_1")
```
